Within the outline is not darkness but anti-light: a negative space where the battle background is inverted, as if the creature is a hole in the world. Còr's null-lantern floats at the centre of its chest, still lit with inverted cold-violet. The face is a smooth featureless oval of pure absence. No eyes. It is the saddest design in the game — it looks like grief given form.
art.direction: The final boss that makes players feel the weight of the story's moral. Not hateable — heartbreaking. The memory of this fight is the one that lasts.

dex.entry: The Dawn Legendary — the kin that was always there, sleeping beneath Dawnstead in a sealed reliquary of sunrise-stone, waiting for the day that never came. art.silhouette: A lion-stag — lion's body with a stag's great antlers — made of and wreathed in actual sunlight. The coat is amber-to-white radiance, the mane a full halo of solar corona arcs in diamond-cyan and fire-orange. The antlers are molten gold with sun-flare tips, casting hard shadows in every direction. Eyes are two full solar discs: white-hot centres with amber halos. In the post-game palette of true daylight colours, it reads as a creature from a different, brighter world — because it is.

dex.entry: A sprout-cub that wears a four-leaf clover like a tiny lantern-leaf; in the Long Dusk the clover gathers what light remains and glows a gentle green. A Cloverkit that trusts you is said to share its luck.

art.silhouette: Small leaf-fox sprout cub; a four-leaf clover sprouts from the top of its head, large pointed leaf-ears, lime-green face and cream underbelly, big friendly dark eyes, soft leafy tufts; faint seed-sparkles drift around it. dex.entry: Cloverkit's kindled form: a great clover-crowned stag whose antlers bloom with year-round green even beneath the dark sky. It plants its hooves and shields the grove, taking blows that would fell lesser kin. The cub you raised became the forest's gentle guardian.

art.silhouette: Tall, sturdy clover-crowned forest stag; broad antlers blooming with four-leaf clovers and moss, deep-green coat, cream chest, a mossy mane, planted hooves; calm guardian gaze. Bold readable silhouette at 64px. Deep verdant greens with gold-green clover accents and an ink outline.
art.palette: Tall, sturdy clover-crowned forest stag; broad antlers blooming with four-leaf clovers and moss, deep-green coat, cream chest, a mossy mane, planted hooves; calm guardian gaze. Bold readable silhouette at 64px. Deep verdant greens with gold-green clover accents and an ink outline.
art.direction: The satisfying payoff of raising your clover-cub — a majestic, immovable grove-guardian stag.

dex.entry: Vulpyre's kindled middle form — a lean adolescent ember-fox caught between kit and crown. art.direction: The steady middle verse of the tide-song — your pond-friend learning to be a harbour wall.

dex.entry: Cloverkit's kindled middle form — a young grove buck whose first antlers have budded as soft green sprigs, each tipped with a tiny folded clover not yet in bloom. Gangly and brave, it stands its ground before it really has the size for it, glowing faintly where the clover gathers what light remains.

art.silhouette: Young leaf-deer, lime-and-deep-green coat with cream chest; slender budding antlers as curling green sprigs tipped with folded clovers; the head-clover from its kit days now worn like a small crown sprout; long legs, big dark earnest eyes. Between Cloverkit's sprout-cub and Cloverhart's broad clover-crowned stag at 64px.

dex.entry: The First Hour — the keeper of dusk, grown heavy with an evening it has never been allowed to put down. Lamp-tenders say every wick in Vesperholm is lit from the one coal it carries, at one remove or another.

art.silhouette: A long, low lynx-like beast, heavy-lidded and patient, built close to the ground like something settling in for the night. A banked mane of small, steady flame-tongues runs low along the neck and shoulders — embers, not fire. At its chest, a locket of teal sea-glass holds one bright coal. The tail ends in a slow curl of pale smoke. Reads at 64px as a dark animal carrying one precious light.
art.palette: Charcoal-violet fur deepening to ink (#1a1430) along the spine like a sky losing its light; ember amber (#ff8a3d) and rose for the banked mane; diamond-teal sea-glass locket; a faint dusk-rose gradient on the brow and flanks.
art.direction: The moment of lamp-lighting as an animal. Heavy, warm at the core, unhurried — the dusk as a keeper, not a threat. The single chest-coal must read as the brightest pixel on the sprite.

dex.entry: The Still Hour — the keeper of midnight, standing the same unrelieved watch since the night stopped turning. The Hollowing call it proof that the dark can be gentle; Noctilune, for its part, has never once answered them.

art.silhouette: A huge pangolin-like sentinel, its overlapping scales panes of midnight-blue glass, each pane holding exactly one star-speck. Standing, it reads as a hooded watchman; curled, as a dark moonless disc. A small unstruck bell of dark ice hangs at its throat. Eyes are two thin silver crescents. At 64px it should read like a piece of the midnight sky knelt down to wait.
art.palette: Night (#0b1026) and deepBlue (#13205a) scale-panes; diamond (#9fe7ff) star-specks, one per scale; pale moon-grey underbelly and claws; the throat-bell a darker, colder blue than everything around it.
art.direction: The deep of night as armour. Utterly still until it isn't. No menace — endurance. The unstruck bell is the motif: midnight is the hour no bell marks.

dex.entry: The Lost Hour — the keeper of a dawn that has not come, waiting half-finished where the morning was meant to land. Those who meet it say the worst part is its patience: it does not doubt the sunrise, and it will not be told the years.

art.silhouette: A tall, slender hare of pale gold light, mid-stride even when standing. Long ears trail behind it like horizon ribbons. Parts of its outline are UNFINISHED — one hindquarter and the tip of one ear fade into faint sketch-lines of light, as if the painter stopped at the moment the dawn did. The missing parts must read as waiting, not wounded.
art.palette: Bone (#f5f0e1) and pale gold body; a sunrise gradient of rose and amber along the spine and ear-ribbons; the unfinished edges in faint diamond-cyan (#9fe7ff) sketch-lines over transparency.
art.direction: An unfinished sunrise as a creature — fast, gentle, heartbreaking. The emotional apex of the triad: in the Long Dusk it is incomplete by definition, and the sprite should make the player want to fix that.
